name: Plan d'action 2035
headline: 10,000 MW
sub: Wind, plus pumped storage and new hydro
body: Hydro-Québec's build-out plan to 2035. Sets the ceiling for every tender that follows and, by extension, the size of the financing market.

name: A/O 2026-01
headline: 1,500–3,000 MW
body: Launched 10 April 2026. First-round bids close 26 February 2027. The next visible concentration of sponsor and lender activity in Quebec renewables.

name: Parcs éoliens Des Neiges
headline: 1,200 MW
body: Three 400 MW sectors, traced to an April 2022 partnership. South and Charlevoix broke ground 31 March 2026, with 114 turbines and over C$2B invested. Commissioning is set for 2027 and 2028. West sector not yet sited. Financing structure not disclosed.

name: A/O 2023-01
headline: 1,550 MW
body: Awarded at an average supply cost of 7.8¢/kWh in 2023 dollars, excluding transmission and balancing. Per-developer pricing is sealed in the Régie docket.

name: LaSalle campus
headline: C$250M
body: A sovereign AI research hub announced 25 September 2025 for the LaSalle borough of Montreal. Financing structure not disclosed. The clearest Quebec case of AI compute being built where the power is.
